tasks.title: Fix TypeScript Compilation Errors
tasks.description: Fix TypeScript errors in lib/prisma.ts:13 (logging config type) and lib/stripe.ts:16 (Stripe API version mismatch) to enable successful builds.
tasks.details:
Two blocking TypeScript errors need resolution:
1. lib/prisma.ts:13 - Type 'string[]' not assignable to Prisma logging config
2. lib/stripe.ts:16 - Stripe API version '2024-06-20' may not match installed package version

These must be fixed before any other development can proceed.
tasks.testStrategy: Run 'npm run typecheck' and verify 0 errors. Run 'npm run build' to confirm production build succeeds.

tasks.title: Update Next.js to Fix Security Vulnerabilities
tasks.description: Upgrade Next.js from 14.0.4 to 14.2.35+ to address critical security vulnerabilities including SSRF, cache poisoning, and DoS attacks.
tasks.details:
Current Next.js 14.0.4 has 13 known vulnerabilities:
- Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
- Cache Poisoning
- Denial of Service (DoS)
- Authorization bypass
- Content injection

Run: npm audit fix --force
Verify: npm audit shows 0 critical vulnerabilities
tasks.testStrategy: Run 'npm audit' and verify no critical vulnerabilities. Run 'npm run dev' to ensure app still starts correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Equipment API Routes
tasks.description: Implement the empty /api/equipment/route.ts with GET (list all) and POST (create) endpoints, and create /api/equipment/[id]/route.ts with GET, PUT, DELETE endpoints.
tasks.details:
Current /api/equipment/route.ts is 0 bytes. Implement:

GET /api/equipment:
- List all equipment with optional category/location filters
- Include owner details
- Use lib/types.ts interfaces

POST /api/equipment:
- Create equipment (authenticated owners only)
- Use lib/validation.ts validateEquipment()
- Handle image and location fields

GET/PUT/DELETE /api/equipment/[id]:
- Get single equipment with owner
- Update equipment (owner only)
- Delete equipment (owner only)
tasks.testStrategy: Test with curl/Postman: GET returns equipment array, POST creates equipment, PUT updates, DELETE removes. Verify validation rejects invalid data.

tasks.title: Implement Search API with Unfulfilled Logging
tasks.description: Create /api/equipment/search/route.ts POST endpoint that searches equipment and logs unfulfilled searches to SearchLog table.
tasks.details:
POST /api/equipment/search:
- Accept: { query: string, category?: string, location?: string }
- Search equipment by title, description, category, location
- Use Prisma full-text search or LIKE queries
- Return: { results: Equipment[], count: number, fulfilled: boolean }

Unfulfilled Search Logging:
- If count === 0, log to SearchLog with fulfilled=false
- Include query, category, userId (if authenticated)
- This powers the admin market gap analysis
tasks.testStrategy: Search for existing equipment (should return results, fulfilled=true). Search for non-existent equipment (should return empty, fulfilled=false, log created in SearchLog).

tasks.title: Implement Bookings API Routes
tasks.description: Implement /api/bookings/route.ts with GET (list user's bookings) and POST (create booking), plus /api/bookings/[id]/route.ts for status updates.
tasks.details:
GET /api/bookings:
- List authenticated user's bookings
- Include equipment details
- Sort by date descending

POST /api/bookings:
- Create booking with equipmentId, startDate, endDate
- Validate dates (start < end, not in past)
- Check equipment availability (no overlapping bookings)
- Calculate totalPrice from dailyRate * days

PATCH /api/bookings/[id]:
- Update status (cancel, confirm)
- Only booking owner or admin can update
- Set cancelledAt and cancellationReason on cancel
tasks.testStrategy: Create booking, verify it appears in GET. Try overlapping booking (should fail). Cancel booking, verify status updated.

tasks.title: Implement Stripe Connect API Routes
tasks.description: Create /api/stripe/connect/ routes for account creation, status checking, and onboarding link generation using existing stripeService.
tasks.details:
lib/stripe.ts already has all service methods. Create routes to expose them:

POST /api/stripe/connect/account:
- Create connected account for authenticated owner
- Use stripeService.createConnectedAccount(userId)
- Return { accountId: string }

GET /api/stripe/connect/account-status:
- Check owner's account readiness
- Use stripeService.getAccountStatus(accountId)
- Return { readyForPayments, requirements }

GET /api/stripe/connect/onboarding-link:
- Generate Stripe onboarding URL
- Use stripeService.createAccountLink(accountId)
- Return { url: string }
tasks.testStrategy: Create account (returns accountId). Check status (returns requirements). Get onboarding link (returns valid Stripe URL).

tasks.title: Implement Stripe Checkout and Webhook Routes
tasks.description: Create /api/stripe/checkout for payment sessions and /api/stripe/webhook for handling Stripe events.
tasks.details:
POST /api/stripe/checkout:
- Accept: { equipmentId: string, days: number }
- Validate equipment exists and owner has Stripe account
- Use stripeService.createCheckoutSession()
- Return { sessionId, url }

POST /api/stripe/webhook:
- Verify signature with stripeService.validateWebhookSignature()
- Handle checkout.session.completed:
  - Find/create booking
  - Set status to CONFIRMED
- Handle checkout.session.expired:
  - Set booking status to CANCELLED
- Return { received: true }
tasks.testStrategy: Create checkout session (returns Stripe URL). Simulate webhook with Stripe CLI: stripe trigger checkout.session.completed. Verify booking status updated.

tasks.title: Implement Analytics API Routes
tasks.description: Create /api/analytics/ routes for unfulfilled searches, market gaps, and owner stats (admin/owner only).
tasks.details:
GET /api/analytics/unfulfilled-searches (Admin only):
- Query SearchLog where fulfilled=false
- Group by query, count occurrences
- Return top 20 most searched unfulfilled queries

GET /api/analytics/market-gaps (Admin only):
- Analyze SearchLog vs Equipment
- Find categories with high search volume but low listings
- Return gap analysis with recommendations

GET /api/analytics/owner-stats (Owner only):
- Count owner's equipment listings
- Count bookings for owner's equipment
- Sum revenue from completed bookings
- Return { totalListings, totalBookings, totalRevenue }
tasks.testStrategy: Create unfulfilled searches, verify they appear in analytics. Check owner stats match database. Verify admin-only access control.

tasks.title: Implement Design System and UI Polish
tasks.description: Establish consistent design system with color palette, typography, spacing, and component styling across the application.
tasks.details:
Create cohesive visual identity:

1. Design Tokens:
- Color palette (primary, secondary, accent, neutrals)
- Typography scale (headings, body, captions)
- Spacing system (4px grid)
- Border radius, shadows

2. Component Styling:
- Buttons (primary, secondary, ghost, danger)
- Cards (equipment, booking, stats)
- Forms (inputs, selects, errors)
- Navigation (header, sidebar, mobile)

3. Responsive Design:
- Mobile-first approach
- Breakpoints: sm(640), md(768), lg(1024), xl(1280)
- Touch-friendly targets (44px minimum)

4. Accessibility:
- Color contrast ratios (WCAG AA)
- Focus states
- Screen reader support
tasks.testStrategy: Visual regression testing across breakpoints. Lighthouse accessibility audit. Manual review of all pages for consistency.

tasks.title: End-to-End Testing and Quality Assurance
tasks.description: Comprehensive testing of all features including equipment CRUD, search, bookings, payments, and admin functions.
tasks.details:
Test all user flows:

1. Renter Flow:
- Browse equipment
- Search (fulfilled and unfulfilled)
- View equipment details
- Book equipment
- Complete checkout
- View booking history

2. Owner Flow:
- Complete Stripe onboarding
- Create equipment listing
- Edit/delete listings
- View bookings for equipment
- Check revenue stats

3. Admin Flow:
- View platform dashboard
- Analyze unfulfilled searches
- Manage users

4. Error Handling:
- Invalid inputs
- Network failures
- Unauthorized access
tasks.testStrategy: Manual walkthrough of all flows. Document any bugs found. Verify all error states handled gracefully. Final build and deployment test.
